decisions.statement: The track named is the one whose carrier holds the id Spotify says.
A track is found by any of the ids its carriers hold.
A player holding a track rather than playing it is read the same way.
A refusal says the Spotify id and the title Spotify gives.
The track played last is the first Spotify names among the tracks played recently.
That first track is the one before what is playing, and the last heard where nothing plays.

definition: the track page a Spotify track points at
